Downloads folder behavior vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Safari and Files download routing covers storefront language. URLSession, Files locations, and Connect actually separate download behavior from product-page copy:

  • Files → Browse → Downloads — the system Downloads location where Safari saves files and where download managers surface completed transfers. Controls where files land on device — not App Store language. AppLocale does not configure this.
  • Safari download routing — when Safari saves a PDF, zip, or video to Downloads, or when your app markets opening those Safari downloads. Listing copy names that workflow; implementing download handlers is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Downloaded PDFs, zips & videos in Downloads — the folder grid buyers browse after a download completes. Gallery overlays should name those file types in zh-Hans when your English frames show Downloads folder contents — not English-only "Downloads" pasted through machine translation.
  • Open from Downloads & manage downloads — user-facing actions to browse, organize, or clear the Downloads folder. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; implementing folder indexing or cleanup UI is in-app engineering.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Downloads support in the binary.

Working Downloads integration and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Downloads, Safari downloads, and 下载项 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you wire URLSession or FileProvider in code.

Downloads-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Downloads folder listings use vocabulary general Files guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe Apple's Downloads location — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Downloads & 下载项

US pages use "Downloads" on the Files Browse sidebar and folder headers. Apple's Simplified Chinese Files vocabulary uses 下载项 for the Downloads location hero, with 下载 on shorter badges and download-action labels. AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing download capabilities your app does not support.

Safari downloads & Safari 下载

Many Downloads marketing screenshots show files saved from Safari — PDFs, archives, or videos with Safari download chrome. zh-Hans copy should describe that workflow with Safari 下载 or 从 Safari 下载 when your English frames use "Safari downloads" — distinct from general Safari browser tab marketing on the Safari listing guide.

Downloaded files & 已下载

Completed-download frames show PDFs, zips, and videos already sitting in Downloads. zh-Hans caption lines should name that state: 已下载 or 已下载的文件 for "downloaded files" badges — not English "Downloaded" pasted through machine translation.

PDFs, zips & videos in Downloads

Downloads folder grids often mix file types. zh-Hans description and caption copy should name the types your gallery actually shows — PDF 文件, 压缩包, 视频 — when your English listing claims those formats land in Downloads.

Do not conflate with iCloud Drive or On My iPhone

Downloads is a local Browse location for completed transfers — often from Safari. iCloud Drive is Apple's cloud disk — 云盘. On My iPhone is device-local storage. If your app supports multiple locations, scope each screenshot frame accurately.

Do not conflate with document picker or Files Browse hub

Open in Files and Import PDF sheets are document-picker workflows — not the Downloads folder hero. Listing copy about 在文件中打开 belongs on the Files browser guide, not Downloads folder frames unless your English listing explicitly compares both surfaces.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Downloads-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 下载项, 下载, Safari 下载, and 已下载 each signal different intent from iCloud 云盘 keywords or Safari 浏览器 keywords.
